theater: 頓巴斯與烏克蘭東南戰線

battle.name: 俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭
battle.theater: 頓巴斯與烏克蘭東南戰線
battle.brief: 2022年2月24日俄軍自北、東、南三面展開攻勢，四月兵臨基輔，五月圍困馬里烏波爾，速決戰最終拖成塹壕消耗戰。卡面T-72B主戰坦克是俄軍裝甲縱隊的骨幹，與2S19自行加榴炮協同衝擊烏軍塹壕；同一型號落到烏軍手中，則成為反擊與重建裝甲部隊的資源。

kit.name: 主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72B是俄羅斯地面部隊的主戰坦克，位於裝甲作戰核心，負責突破防線、護送步兵及提供機動火力，並與自走榴彈砲協同作戰。

countries: 交戰雙方是俄羅斯與烏克蘭。俄方主體是聯邦武裝力量，四個軍區在同一時間開火：西部軍區的第36合成軍集團軍、第1近衛坦克集團軍與第29、第3、第4合成軍集團軍自別爾戈羅德與布良斯克向基輔方向推進；南部軍區的第58、第41、第36合成軍集團軍及第8集團軍自克里米亞向梅利托波爾、馬里烏波爾與頓涅茨克方向攻擊；東部軍區與頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克兩地武裝沿既有接觸線作戰。空降兵第31、第76、第98空降師、內務部特種部隊與車臣武裝承擔開局奇襲與奪點任務；瓦格納集團以武裝志願人員形式獨立參戰；俄羅斯國民近衛軍與後方部隊負責佔領區的接管。北線的實際作戰依托白俄羅斯境內集結的部隊展開，白方並未派地面部隊進入烏克蘭。烏方由武裝部隊總司令部統一調度，陸軍以步兵旅、機械化旅、坦克旅為基本單位，第93、第72機械化旅與第4坦克旅、第3獨立坦克旅、第92與第80突擊旅、第14機械化旅等構成東線骨架；國民兵、國土防衛部隊、亞速團（第36海兵旅的前身）、空軍與無人機部隊，以及克里米亞方向的海上小艇與水雷分隊分擔其餘方向。外部方面，北約未派地面部隊，但自2022年起以武器、情報、訓練與後勤持續支援；伊朗的見證系列無人機自2022年9月起出現在烏克蘭戰場，朝鮮自2023年起向俄方供應彈藥與導彈。
countriesEn: The two belligerents are Russia and Ukraine. The Russian field effort was carried by the federal armed forces, with all four military districts striking at once: the Western Military District fielded the 36th Combined Arms Army, the 1st Guards Tank Army and the 29th, 3rd and 4th Combined Arms Armies pushing out of Belgorod and Bryansk toward Kyiv; the Southern Military District committed the 58th, 41st and 36th Combined Arms Armies and the 8th Army from Crimea toward Melitopol, Mariupol and Donetsk; the Eastern Military District and the armed formations of the self-proclaimed Donetsk and Luhansk republics fought along the pre-existing line of contact. The 31st, 76th and 98th Airborne Divisions, Interior Ministry special forces and Chechen formations carried the opening assault and the seizure of key ground; the Wagner Group took part as an independent body of armed volunteers; the National Guard and rear-area units took over the occupied territory. The northern thrust was actually fought by formations staged inside Belarus, which supplied the depth and the logistics, although Belarusian ground troops did not enter Ukraine. On the Ukrainian side the General Staff of the Armed Forces directed everything, the army being organised around infantry, mechanised and tank brigades: the 93rd and 72nd Mechanised Brigades together with the 4th Tank Brigade, the 3rd Separate Tank Brigade, the 92nd and 80th Assault Brigades and the 14th Mechanised Brigade formed the backbone of the eastern front; the National Guard, the Territorial Defence Forces, the Azov Regiment (later the 36th Marine Brigade), the air force with its drone units, and small craft and mine warfare in the Crimea direction carried the remaining directions. Outside the two states, no NATO member committed ground forces, but weapons, intelligence, training and logistics support have been delivered since 2022; Iranian Shahed-series drones appeared on the Ukrainian battlefield from September 2022, and from 2023 North Korea supplied ammunition and missiles to the Russian side.
people: 關鍵人物方面，普京以「特別軍事行動」的名義下令全面進攻，國防部長紹伊古與總參謀長格拉西莫夫負責軍務統籌，南部軍區司令德沃爾尼科夫被指定為本次行動的直接指揮者，第1、第2、第3合成軍集團軍的指揮官分別是什特魯克、庫圖佐夫與日瓦廖夫。瓦格納方面由普里戈津率領，車臣方面為卡德羅夫，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩地武裝的負責人則是普希林與帕塞奇尼克。烏克蘭方面，總統澤連斯基在開戰之後留駐基輔主持全局，武裝部隊總司令先後由扎盧日尼（任至2023年6月）與瑟爾斯基接任，陸軍司令由霍姆恰克交予瑟爾斯基，國防部長由列克尼科夫交至列茲紐克，總統辦公室主任耶爾馬克參與西方援助的協調。前線指揮層中，亞速團與後來第36海兵旅的指揮官在馬里烏波爾的最後守備中扮演關鍵角色，第92突擊旅等部在2022年秋的哈爾科夫反攻中投入首線；瓦格納與俄軍正規部隊在巴赫穆特方向長期的競逐，也暴露了兩套指揮體系之間的摩擦。
peopleEn: On the Russian side Putin ordered the full-scale offensive under the name of the 'special military operation', with Defence Minister Shoigu and Chief of the General Staff Gerasimov handling the military direction, and Southern Military District commander Dvornikov designated as the operational commander of the campaign; the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Combined Arms Armies were commanded by Shtryuk, Kutuzov and Zhuravlyov respectively. Wagner was led by Prigozhin, the Chechen contingent by Kadyrov, and the self-proclaimed Donetsk and Luhansk formations by Pushilin and Pasechnik. On the Ukrainian side President Zelensky remained in Kyiv after the invasion began and ran the state from there; the post of Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces passed from Zaluzhnyi (until June 2023) to Syrskyi, the Ground Forces command passed from Khomchak to Syrskyi, the defence ministry from Reznikov to Leznyuk, and the head of the presidential office Yermak took part in coordinating Western assistance. Among the front-line commanders, the regimental commanders of the Azov Regiment and of the 36th Marine Brigade that followed it played the decisive part in the last stand at Mariupol, while units such as the 92nd Assault Brigade were committed to the spearhead of the Ukrainian counter-offensive at Kharkiv in the autumn of 2022; the long competition at Bakhmut between Wagner and the regular Russian formations also exposed friction between two separate command systems.
kits: 裝備方面，卡面兵器T-72B是蘇聯1980年代中期定型的改進型主戰坦克：125毫米滑膛炮、45發備彈、V-46-6型柴油發動機、公路時速約60公里，戰鬥全重約41噸。在俄軍編制內，T-72B是坦克旅與摩托化步兵旅所屬坦克營的標準配屬，負責突破步兵防線、掩護步兵與提供機動射擊，並與2S19自行加榴炮、2S35自行榴彈炮、9A52火箭炮等火炮群協同；常見的升級件是加掛「帳篷」反裝甲炸藥的T-72B3，以及配備9M117或9K514反坦克導彈的改裝車。俄軍在烏克蘭的實際裝備結構遠不如紙面整齊：光學瞄具、熱成像與火控計算機大量沿用蘇聯時期存量，紅外線探測與夜間觀察能力不足，部分車輛在出廠前已拆除主動防護或反裝甲模組以求減重，整車作戰壽命與備件供應都被消耗戰拖長。烏克蘭一方的裝備以T-64BV與T-72B3為主，另有BTR-4、BMP-2與BMP-3、2S19自行加榴炮、Buk-M1防空系統、S-300防空系統、NLAW與刺針反坦克導彈，並大量使用TB2無人機、「柳葉」巡飛彈與第一線FPV無人機。蘇聯解體後烏克蘭也接收過一批T-72B3，2022年之後又把俄軍繳獲的T-72B3與T-90A整修後重新編成裝甲營，繼續投入東線。
kitsEn: On the equipment side, the T-72B shown on the card is the improved main battle tank fielded by the Soviet Union in the mid-1980s: a 125 mm smoothbore gun, 45 rounds of main ammunition, the V-46-6 diesel engine, a road speed of roughly 60 km/h and a combat weight of about 41 tonnes. Within the Russian order of battle the T-72B was the standard issue of the tank companies of tank brigades and motor rifle brigades; it was used to break infantry defensive lines, to shield foot infantry and to provide mobile fire, in combination with the 2S19 self-propelled howitzer, the 2S35 self-propelled gun and the 9A52 rocket launcher. Common upgrade forms were the T-72B3 with Kontakt-5 explosive reactive armour and the T-72B3 fitted with the 9M117 or 9K514 guided anti-tank missiles. The actual equipment structure of the Russian army in Ukraine was far less tidy than the paper order of battle: optical sights, thermal imaging and fire-control computers were overwhelmingly Soviet-era stock, infrared detection and night observation were thin, and some vehicles had their active protection or reactive armour removed before issue in order to save weight, while service life and spare-part supply were stretched by a war of attrition. The Ukrainian equipment base was centred on the T-64BV and the T-72B3, together with the BTR-4, BMP-2 and BMP-3 infantry fighting vehicles, the 2S19 self-propelled howitzer, the Buk-M1 and S-300 air defence systems, NLAW and Javelin anti-tank guided missiles, and heavy reliance on TB2 drones, Lancet loitering munitions and first-line FPV drones. Ukraine had already received a batch of T-72B3 after the dissolution of the Soviet Union, and after 2022 it rebuilt captured Russian T-72B3 and T-90A vehicles into new tank companies committed to the eastern front.
tactics: 戰術層面上，2022年2月24日的進攻是多軸同步的：導彈與空襲先打掉烏克蘭的防空雷達、機場與指揮節點，空降兵隨即奪取沃斯托梅爾與瓦西爾克夫附近的機場，北線縱隊沿高速公路長驅直入。這種沿公路線性推進的「犁式突進」，在烏克蘭的縱深反坦克導彈、地雷、無人機投擲反戰車雷與小組反坦克火力面前迅速消耗，尤以布查一役最為明顯，進攻方步兵與砲兵支援脫節的問題暴露無遺。烏軍的戰術特徵是縱深梯次與塹壕化：第93、第72機械化旅在阿夫迪夫卡、馬里烏波爾、馬里烏波爾外圍等據點構築多層塹壕與地雷帶，坦克以射孔姿態停在掩體後方，只用火力與反坦克導彈支援步兵；T-72B3加掛9M117導彈，可在射擊陣位上直接打擊塹壕內的目標而不必正面暴露。俄軍的對應做法是改以炮兵與火箭炮的密集火力支援遠程突進的裝甲縱隊，並大量使用FPV無人機與巡飛彈攻擊暴露的裝甲。2022年秋，烏軍在哈爾科夫方向實施反攻，切斷伊久姆與庫皮揚斯克方向的俄軍補給；瓦格納則以小隊規模的突進配合炮火支援，在索萊達爾與巴赫穆特方向長期消耗。此後戰線轉為沿約一千公里接觸線的長期炮兵戰與塹壕對峙。
tacticsEn: Tactically the opening of 24 February 2022 was synchronised across multiple axes: missile strikes and air attacks first destroyed Ukrainian air defence radars, airfields and command nodes, airborne troops then seized the airfields near Hostomel and Vasylkiv, and the northern columns drove straight down the highways. This linear advance along the roads, the so-called barnstorming, was quickly consumed by Ukrainian depth defence: anti-tank guided missiles, mines, drone-dropped anti-tank mines and small-unit anti-tank action, with the failure of infantry and artillery support for the attackers clearest of all at Bucha. The Ukrainian tactical signature was depth echeloning and entrenchment: the 93rd and 72nd Mechanised Brigades built multiple trench lines and mine belts at Avdiivka, Mariupol and Makintosh-style positions, with tanks sitting in firing slits behind cover, supporting infantry with fire and anti-tank missiles alone; a T-72B3 carrying the 9M117 could strike targets inside trenches directly from a firing position without exposing itself frontally. The Russian answer was to support long-range armoured thrusts with dense artillery and rocket fire, and to hunt exposed armour with massed FPV drones and loitering munitions. In the autumn of 2022 Ukraine counter-attacked in the Kharkiv direction, cutting Russian supply lines toward Izium and Kupiansk, while Wagner advanced in small teams under artillery support in a grinding battle for Soledar and Bakhmut. Thereafter the front settled into a long artillery war and a trench duel along a line of contact of roughly a thousand kilometres.
data: 數字方面，開戰前美方公開評估估計俄方在烏克蘭境內集結的兵力約十六萬九千至十九萬人，配有約三千一百至三千五百五十輛坦克與裝甲車輛（其中坦克約九百至一千零六十輛），以及約一千三百七十至一千八百七十門火砲與火箭砲；到2022年3月，部分評估認為其地面部隊已增至二十萬上下。烏方武裝部隊的總規模據國際軍備研究機構估算約在二十萬上下（含國民兵與國土防衛部隊），但精銳裝甲部隊與重裝備數量遠少於俄方。戰損數字各方口徑差異極大：烏方宣稱至2022年底俄軍人員損失以數萬計、裝甲車輛損失逾一萬輛；美方與智庫的評估則普遍認為俄軍在2022年內摧毀或受損的坦克在一千輛上下，累積至2023年春接近兩千輛，說法不一，須視統計口徑而定。T-72B系列的損失原因分布很特殊：2022年主要死於反坦克導彈、機載炸藥與地雷，2023年後則更多是120毫米迫擊炮與炮火直接命中。烏方在2022年下半年至2023年間接收並整修了一批俄軍繳獲的T-72B3與T-90A，數量在數十輛上下，重新編成裝甲單位投入東線，同期烏軍自身T-72B3的損失亦以數十輛計。戰線全長約一千公里，雙方火力接觸帶的縱深多在數公里之內，而補給線卻要向後延伸數百公里。
dataEn: On the numbers, Western assessments published before the invasion put the Russian force massed inside Ukraine at roughly 169,000 to 190,000 personnel, with about 3,130 to 3,550 tanks and armoured fighting vehicles (of which around 900 to 1,060 tanks) and roughly 1,370 to 1,870 artillery and rocket systems; by March 2022 some assessments put the ground forces nearer 200,000. The total size of the Ukrainian armed forces was estimated by international arms-control institutes at around 200,000 including the National Guard and the Territorial Defence Forces, but the quantity of trained armour and heavy equipment was far smaller than the Russian side. Loss figures vary enormously by source: Ukrainian claims had Russian personnel losses in the tens of thousands and more than ten thousand armoured vehicles lost by the end of 2022, while US and think-tank assessments generally put Russian tanks destroyed or damaged in 2022 at around a thousand, rising towards two thousand by the spring of 2023; the discrepancies reflect counting method rather than a single verifiable figure. The pattern of T-72B losses is distinctive: in 2022 the great majority were killed by anti-tank guided missiles, airborne bombs and mines, while from 2023 more were destroyed by 120 mm mortar and artillery direct hits. Between the second half of 2022 and 2023 Ukraine received and rebuilt a batch of Russian T-72B3 and T-90A vehicles captured from the enemy, numbering in the tens, forming them into new armoured units committed to the eastern front, while Ukrainian T-72B3 losses in the same period were also counted in the tens. The front line runs for about a thousand kilometres, the depth of direct fire contact on both sides rarely exceeding a few kilometres, while the supply lines behind it stretch for hundreds of kilometres.
cause: 起因方面，衝突的遠因是2014年克里米亞被俄羅斯吞併、頓巴斯爆發戰事，以及《明斯克協議》未能落實——協議要求烏克蘭撤走重武器、給予頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克地方自治權與地方選舉，這三項均未完整執行。俄方把2014年後始終未能納入自身框架的烏克蘭視為地緣安全問題的核心，主張北約不得把武裝力量延伸至烏克蘭境內、烏克蘭非軍事化，並清除「納粹化」與去共產化的極端派。2021年秋冬起，俄方在烏克蘭邊境集結大量部隊與後勤物資，先以軍演、邊境騷擾，以及在天然氣、航運與貿易上施加的壓力逐步加碼；2022年2月15日之後要求烏方將北約相關設施交出並撤軍，遭拒絕。2月18日，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩地武裝宣布願以武力「保護」自身並請求俄方「護衛」，2月21日俄方承認兩者為獨立國家，2月24日隨即宣布對烏克蘭開展「特別軍事行動」，同日以導彈與地面縱隊展開全面進攻。關於開戰是否早已被決定，各方並無公開文件可以證實，但2021年10月起大規模集結的規模、兵種構成與2022年2月的部署方式，被多數研究視為一次難以隨時中止的既定計劃。
causeEn: As for causes, the distant background is the Russian annexation of Crimea in 2014, the outbreak of fighting in the Donbas, and the failure of the Minsk agreements to be implemented: the protocol required Ukraine to withdraw heavy weapons and to grant the Donetsk and Luhansk regions local self-government and local elections, and none of the three was fully carried out. Russia came to treat the Ukraine, which it had never managed to bring into its own framework after 2014, as the core of its geopolitical security problem, arguing that NATO must not extend armed forces into Ukrainian territory, that Ukraine must be demilitarised, and that 'denazification' and decommunisation of extremists must be carried out. From the autumn of 2021 Russia massed large forces and logistic stocks along the Ukrainian border, escalating gradually through military exercises, border harassment and pressure on gas supplies, shipping and trade; after 15 February 2022 it demanded that Ukraine hand over NATO-related facilities and withdraw, and was refused. On 18 February the Donetsk and Luhansk formations announced their readiness to defend themselves by force and to ask Russia for protection; on 21 February Russia recognised both as independent states; on 24 February it declared the 'special military operation' against Ukraine and opened the general offensive with missiles and ground columns the same day. There is no public document establishing whether the decision to attack had been taken in advance, but the scale, the composition of forces and the pattern of deployment of the massive build-up that began in October 2021, together with the February 2022 deployments, are treated by most studies as a plan already under way that could not easily be halted.
impact: 影響方面，這場戰爭把歐洲的安全結構整體推移：北約東翼的軍費大幅增加，芬蘭與瑞典相繼申請加入；聯合國大會以壓倒性票數通過譴責俄羅斯侵略的決議，國際法院裁定俄方必須停止軍事行動，國際刑事法院更對俄羅斯總統等人發出拘捕令，長期改變了國際司法與制裁的秩序。軍事技術層面，無人機成為常規消耗品，從TB2的偵察打擊、「柳葉」到FPV無人機與無人艇，戰場上出現大量新編制；俄軍則被迫在失去西方光學瞄具與火控供應的情況下，轉而依靠改裝無人機、恢復以密集火炮戰為核心的裝甲理論來維持戰線。T-72B這類存量裝備的戰時經濟被推到極致：回收陣亡車輛、拆解可用部件、拼裝無人機與巡飛彈，工廠產能成為軍事資源的一部分。烏克蘭方面則完成裝甲部隊的北約標準化改造，重建多支獨立坦克旅，並以無人機部隊與外國顧問重塑火力協調。戰爭同時改寫了物流與貿易：黑海走廊、多瑙河航運、糧食與肥料出口路線全部重新安排，歐洲進口結構與價格都受牽動。
impactEn: In terms of impact, the war pushed the whole European security architecture to one side: defence spending on the NATO eastern flank rose sharply and Finland and Sweden applied in turn to join the alliance; the United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution condemning the Russian aggression by an overwhelming majority, the International Court of Justice ruled that Russia must suspend its military operations, and the International Criminal Court issued arrest warrants for the Russian president and others, permanently altering the order of international justice and sanctions. At the level of military technology the drone became an ordinary item of consumption, from the reconnaissance and strike role of the TB2 to Lancet, FPV drones and unmanned boats, generating a large number of new formations on the battlefield; Russia, cut off from Western optics and fire-control supply, was pushed back toward dense artillery-centred armoured warfare supported by improvised drones. The wartime economy of stored equipment such as the T-72B was pushed to its limit: recovering wrecked vehicles, stripping usable parts and assembling drones and loitering munitions turned factory capacity into a military resource. Ukraine in the meantime completed the NATO-standardisation of its armoured units, rebuilt a number of separate tank brigades, and reshaped its fire coordination around drone units and foreign advisers. The war also rewrote logistics and trade: the Black Sea corridor, Danube navigation and grain and fertiliser export routes were all rearranged, and European import structures and prices were affected.
result: 結果方面，2022年2月24日發動的速決戰最終沒有打成：北線縱隊在基輔近郊受挫，3月底至4月初陸續撤出烏克蘭北部；南線一度進展迅速，取得赫爾松、蛇島與梅利托波爾，但自2022年秋起在哈爾科夫反攻中失去伊久姆與庫皮揚斯克，11月俄方宣布自赫爾松市區撤退，戰線退回第聶伯河下游。東線最為漫長：2022年3月馬里烏波爾市區淪陷，亞速鋼鐵廠的最後守備延續至5月中旬；2023年5月巴赫穆特淪陷；2024年11月波克羅夫斯克方向的戰線再度大幅推進。與此同時，2022年9月30日俄方在佔領區舉行公投並將四州宣告併入版圖，該宣示未獲大多數國家承認。整體而言，雙方都沒有達成開戰時的政治目標：烏克蘭未收復克里米亞與頓巴斯，俄羅斯則未能迫使基輔接受其政治安排，戰爭在寫作此稿時仍未結束，前線大致沿頓巴斯弧線以及扎波羅熱、赫松的接觸線固定。卡面上的T-72B仍在這條線上反覆出現——俄軍用它突擊與守備，烏軍則用它換回失去的裝甲，這一型號的戰時生涯因此被拉得比任何一款同類坦克都長。
resultEn: In the event, the blitzkrieg launched on 24 February 2022 did not succeed: the northern columns were checked outside Kyiv and withdrew from northern Ukraine between late March and early April; the southern thrust made rapid early progress, taking Kherson, Snake Island and Melitopol, but from the autumn of 2022 lost Izium and Kupiansk during the Ukrainian counter-offensive at Kharkiv, and in November the Russian command announced a withdrawal from the city of Kherson, pulling the line back to the lower Dnieper. The eastern front was the longest of all: Mariupol fell in March 2022, with the last defenders of the Azovstal steelworks holding out until mid-May; Bakhmut fell in May 2023; and in November 2024 the line moved forward again by a large margin around Pokrovsk. Meanwhile on 30 September 2022 Russia held referendums in the occupied territory and declared four oblasts annexed, a claim recognised by few states. Overall neither side achieved its political aims at the outset: Ukraine has not recovered Crimea or the Donbas, Russia has not compelled Kyiv to accept its political terms, and the war was still running when this account was written, with the front broadly frozen along the arc of the Donbas and along the lines of contact in Zaporizhzhia and Kherson. The T-72B on the card keeps appearing on that line: Russia uses it for assault and for the defence, while Ukraine uses it to replace the armour it has lost, and the wartime career of this type has thereby outlasted that of every other tank in its class.
